items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Lawrence Brown was in it, Lionel Hampton.

ctx.x: Oh, Lawrence Brown was in it, Lionel Hampton. That's two big ones they had. And then there was another guy who had a band here. I can't think offhand -- But that's about it. There wasn't too much going on musically.
You said when you started -- you headed your own group --
